title: Move the last queue member to the beginning
goal: uses pop and unshift to update arrays and handle empty queues.
summary: Two groups of workbenches are on duty in rotation. When handing over, move the last group to the front, and the order of the other groups remains unchanged.
tasks: complete rotateLast(queue). If it is not empty, take out the last item, put it at the beginning, and then return the entire queue.
allows direct modification of the original array. Empty array returns an empty array.

example.note: pop returns the last item, and unshift returns the length after insertion. To return the entire queue, use the array itself.

hint: first determines the length. Calling pop on an empty array returns undefined.
